logical_interface.observation_order: P04 disk-major four fields, goal one-hot, n/8
logical_interface.action_selection: raw channel-0 six-output argmax, lowest-index ties

channels.0: evolving information and output score; hard-clamped observation at inputs
channels.1_to_5: evolving unlabeled working state; hard-clamped to zero at inputs
channels.6: fixed input-site marker, globally cleared and rewritten
channels.7: fixed output-site marker, globally cleared and rewritten

grid.episode_reset: new seeded grid; persistent between moves

epoch.pre_epoch: clamp current 36 observations and rewrite fixed site markers before first local delta
epoch.mask: one Bernoulli uniform <= 0.5 bit per cell shared across all eight channels; supplied traces supported
epoch.post_residual: clear channels 6/7 globally, fully clamp input sites, rewrite site markers and observation channel 0

training.primary_loss: complete-set optimal-action cross entropy, raw logits
training.dataset_partition: hash identity 80/10/10 within all n=1..8; training stops before held-out trajectory identities

deployment_exclusions: legality mask or direct legality feedback

measured_candidate.disposition: negative policy experiment; no functional freeze
